fact: A year-long pilot from August 2022 to March 2023 with Eswatini's Ministry of Health and CHAI tested Jacaranda Health's AI-enabled PROMPTS two-way SMS tool for infant immunization tracking, enrolling over 1,300 mothers, and the Ministry has since shown interest in expanding it to all facilities.
title: Pilot results: Testing an mHealth approach to reach the last mile of Eswatini's under-immunized infants
